name: Dembow perreo boom
desc: A darker perreo take on the dembow: a boomy low-passed 808 kick on 1 and 3 interlocks with the snare to spell the 3+3+2 (boom-ch-boom-chick), but the hats swing as triplets via elongation and a timbale rimshot ghosts the backbeat. Peak opens into 16th hat rolls with a double-time turnaround.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.4).lpf(1400), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.6).shape(.2).room(.2)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.4).lpf(1400), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.65).shape(.2).room(.2), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.25, ${gain}*.45).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.7, ${hatcut}*1.2).slow(16)), s("~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.35).room(.3)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.45).lpf(1600), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.25).room(.2), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.28, ${gain}*.5).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut}), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.4), s("~ rim ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.38).room(.3)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
